records.source: Dear @,^ How are things going? You must really be making a fortune on that farm. Don't forget your dear old mother when you're a millionaire! ^  Love, Mom   ^   P.S. Enjoy the cake!%item id (O)221 1 %%[#]From Mom #4
records.translation: Mahal kong @,^ Kumusta ka na? Tiyak na malaki na ang kinikita mo sa bukid na iyan. Huwag mong kalimutan ang mahal mong matandang ina kapag milyonaryo ka na! ^  Nagmamahal, Nanay   ^   P.S. Sana magustuhan mo ang keyk!%item id (O)221 1 %%[#]Mula kay Nanay #4

records.source: Dear @,^  Have you settled into your new life yet? I can't believe you're all grown up now... Time sure flies. Now that you're gone I have all this extra money laying around, so I included a little gift.^  Love, Dad.%item money 500 501 %%[#]From Dad
records.translation: Mahal kong @,^  Nasanay ka na ba sa bago mong buhay? Hindi ako makapaniwalang malaki ka na... Ang bilis talaga ng panahon. Ngayong wala ka na rito, may dagdag akong perang hindi nagagamit, kaya naglakip ako ng munting regalo.^  Nagmamahal, Tatay.%item money 500 501 %%[#]Mula kay Tatay
records.englishResidueReason: The literal word 'money' is part of the required %item money runtime reward directive.

records.source: Dear @,^  How is the country life going for you? It's been lonely here without you, but I'm proud of what you're doing.^  Love, Dad  ^  P.S. Found an envelope with some money Grandpa left for you. %item money 500 501 %%[#]From Dad #2
records.translation: Mahal kong @,^  Kumusta ang buhay mo sa kabukiran? Malungkot dito nang wala ka, pero ipinagmamalaki ko ang ginagawa mo.^  Nagmamahal, Tatay  ^  P.S. May nakita akong sobre na may perang iniwan ni Lolo para sa iyo. %item money 500 501 %%[#]Mula kay Tatay #2
records.englishResidueReason: The literal word 'money' is part of the required %item money runtime reward directive.

records.source: Dear @,^  I read an article about you in the local paper! I'm so impressed with your progress on the farm! Keep this up and dear old Dad might be retiring in a fern islands luxury bungalow after all ;).^  Love, Dad[#]From Dad #3
records.translation: Mahal kong @,^  May nabasa akong artikulo tungkol sa iyo sa lokal na pahayagan! Hangang-hanga ako sa pag-unlad mo sa bukid! Ipagpatuloy mo iyan at baka makapagretiro nga ang mahal mong matandang Tatay sa isang marangyang bungalow sa Kapuluan ng Fern ;).^  Nagmamahal, Tatay[#]Mula kay Tatay #3

records.source: Dear @,^ I know you're busy on the farm and that's why you can't visit. I understand. You've been working so hard... keep it up and you can accomplish anything! ^ Love, Dad  ^  P.S. Included some quality stone %item id (O)390 30 %%[#]From Dad #4
records.translation: Mahal kong @,^ Alam kong abala ka sa bukid at iyon ang dahilan kung bakit hindi ka makadalaw. Nauunawaan ko. Napakasipag mo... ipagpatuloy mo iyan at makakamit mo ang kahit ano! ^ Nagmamahal, Tatay  ^  P.S. Naglakip ako ng de-kalidad na Bato %item id (O)390 30 %%[#]Mula kay Tatay #4

records.source: Greetings, @.^It is our pleasure to inform you that your farm will be featured in next week's 'up & coming' column of the Stardew Valley Tribune! Congratulations. We're impressed with your quick progress. ^   -SVT[#]News Story
records.translation: Pagbati, @.^Ikinagagalak naming ipaalam na itatampok ang bukid mo sa kolum na 'Mga Bagong Sisikat' ng Stardew Valley Tribune sa susunod na linggo! Binabati ka namin. Humanga kami sa bilis ng pag-unlad mo. ^   -SVT[#]Balita

records.source: ADVERTISEMENT:^"I keep finding cool stuff, but my backpack is full!"^^Does this sound like you? Well, Pierre's got you covered!^^Stop by Pierre's General Store TODAY and check out our affordable size 24 backpack!^ See you soon![#]Backpacks From Pierre's
records.translation: PATALASTAS:^"Ang dami kong nakikitang magagandang bagay, pero puno na ang backpack ko!"^^Parang ikaw ba ito? records.source: Dear Farmer @,^^I'd like to apologize for joking about your Grandpa's old cottage when we first met. It's really a nice little house!^^However, you might need some more space someday. That's where I can help. If you bring me some raw materials and pay a fee, I can expand your house.^(Continued on next page)^^The first expansion I offer includes a kitchen. With a kitchen, you'll be able to cook any recipes you've learned!^^Anyway, I hope you're starting to feel at home in Stardew Valley!^^    Your local carpenter,^        Robin[#]Robin's Services
records.translation: Mahal kong Magsasaka @,^^Humihingi ako ng paumanhin sa pagbibiro ko tungkol sa lumang munting bahay ng Lolo mo noong una tayong nagkita. Maganda naman talaga ang bahay na iyon!^^Gayunman, baka kailanganin mo ng mas malaking espasyo balang araw. Matutulungan kita riyan. Kung dadalhan mo ako ng mga hilaw na materyales at magbabayad ng kaukulang halaga, mapalalaki ko ang bahay mo.^(Itutuloy sa susunod na pahina)^^May kasamang kusina ang una kong iniaalok na pagpapalawak. Sa kusina, maluluto mo ang anumang resipeng natutuhan mo!^^Sana ay unti-unti mo nang itinuturing na tahanan ang Stardew Valley!^^    Ang karpintero mo rito,^        Robin[#]Mga Serbisyo ni Robin

records.source: @,^I've heard you've been giving some people a hand around town! Everyone seems really thankful. I'm awarding you this month's "Best Neighbor" award (with a small cash prize). Keep it up! ^   -Mayor%item money 500 501 %%[#]Best Neighbor

Ipagpatuloy mo iyan! ^   -Alkalde%item money 500 501 %%[#]Pinakamahusay na Kapitbahay

records.translation: Mahal kong kapitbahay,^Sana ay nakapamuhay ka na nang maayos sa bago mong tahanan. Sumusulat ako upang ipaalam na nagbebenta na ngayon ng mga pataba ang tindahan ni Pierre! Bakit hindi ka dumaan at tingnan kung kaya mong bumili ng ilang dosenang kahon?  ^   -Pierre[#]Mga Pataba ni Pierre

records.source: Dear @,^I am now selling higher quality fertilizers, as well as new crop selections! See you soon. ^   -Pierre[#]Pierre's High Quality Fertilizers

records.source: Dear @,^^Thank you for purchasing a coop upgrade! records.translation: Mahal kong @,^^Salamat sa pagbili ng pagpapahusay sa Kulungan! records.source: @,^I've got a new item in stock... It's called the "Auto-Grabber".^^This thing can milk your cows and goats, shear your sheep, gather eggs, and pluck your wooly rabbits... all on its own!^^It's considered a 'luxury item', so I'm charging 25,000g.^^    -Marnie[#]Auto-Grabber Notice
records.translation: @,^May bago akong paninda... Tinatawag itong "Awtomatikong Tagakolekta".^^Kaya nitong gatasan ang mga baka at kambing mo, gupitan ang mga tupa, tipunin ang mga itlog, at kunin ang lana mula sa mababalahibo mong kuneho... nang mag-isa!^^Itinuturing itong 'marangyang paninda', kaya 25,000g ang presyo ko.^^    -Marnie[#]Abiso sa Awtomatikong Tagakolekta
